ex.t: By and large, the plan was a success.
The drawer was full of odds and ends.
It's a rough and ready solution.
He paced to and fro in the room.
Sooner or later the truth will come out.
The marriage had its ups and downs.
We talked about this and that.
Let's weigh up the pros and cons.
The message came across loud and clear.

title.ko: 고정 짝 표현: by and large · odds and ends · rough and ready · to and fro · sooner or later
title.en: binomials and fixed pairs: by and large, odds and ends, rough and ready, to and fro, sooner or later

explain.ko: 고정 짝 표현(binomial)은 and, or로 연결된 두 낱말이 정해진 순서로 굳어진 표현입니다. by and large(대체로), odds and ends(잡동사니), safe and sound(무사히), ups and downs(우여곡절), pros and cons(장단점)처럼 순서가 바뀌면 어색해집니다. 이런 표현은 음의 리듬과 두운, 각운을 가지는 경우가 많고, 구어와 문어 모두에서 자연스러움을 더해 줍니다.
explain.en: A binomial is a fixed expression of two words linked by and or or in a set order. By and large, odds and ends, safe and sound, ups and downs and pros and cons sound odd if the order is reversed. They often have rhythm, alliteration or rhyme and add naturalness to speech and writing.

notes.ko: 순서를 바꾸지 마세요. (ends and odds는 틀림)
notes.en: Do not reverse the order (ends and odds is wrong).

notes.ko: 격식 있는 글에서는 일부 표현이 구어적일 수 있어요.
notes.en: Some pairs feel informal in formal writing.
Rough and ready works as an adjective.

lines.t: English has many fixed pairs linked by and or or. The order is fixed, so saying ends and odds instead of odds and ends sounds odd. Such pairs give speech and writing a rhythmic, natural feel.

trans.ko: 영어에는 and, or로 연결된 고정 짝 표현이 많습니다. 순서가 고정되어 있어서 odds and ends를 ends and odds라고 하면 어색합니다. 이런 표현은 구어와 문어에서 리듬감 있고 자연스러운 느낌을 줍니다.

questions.q: Why does order matter in binomials?

prompt.ko: 고정 짝 표현(by and large, sooner or later, pros and cons, ups and downs)을 사용해 4문장을 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write four sentences using binomials (by and large, sooner or later, pros and cons, ups and downs).

task.model: Our team had many ups and downs but, by and large, did well. Sooner or later a new project will begin. Before that, we need to weigh the pros and cons. I hope everyone finishes safe and sound.

model_trans.ko: 우리 팀은 우여곡절이 많았지만 대체로 잘 해냈어요. 조만간 새 프로젝트가 시작될 거예요. 그 전에 장단점을 따져 봐야 해요. 모두 무사히 마무리하면 좋겠어요.
model_trans.en: Our team had many ups and downs but, by and large, did well. Sooner or later a new project will begin. Before that, we need to weigh the pros and cons. I hope everyone finishes safe and sound.
